09/07/2026

Supreme®/A.PRESSE

A.PRESSE is a Japanese clothing brand founded by Kazuma Shigematsu in 2021. A.PRESSE draws inspiration from classic workwear, military and tailored pieces – reinterpreting these heritage styles with exceptional quality and precise detail. A.PRESSE is highly regarded for its dedication to meticulous craftsmanship, particularly its custom developed fabrics and vintage finishing techniques.

Supreme has worked with A.PRESSE on a new collection for Fall 2026. The collection consists of a Leather Jacket in both calfskin and cowhide leathers; M-65 and Cargo Pant featuring a hand-applied camo pattern; Suit made with a cotton-silk blend fabric; Shirt made with a David & John Anderson cotton pin Oxford fabric; Tee featuring original photography by Ari Marcopoulos; Hooded Sweatshirt featuring a cotton waffle thermal lining; Camp Cap; Cashmere Beanie; and 20" sterling silver Classic Key Chain. The collection was produced by A.PRESSE in Japan, Portugal, and the USA; and features custom fits developed collaboratively by Supreme and A.PRESSE.

Available September 10th.

Available in Asia September 12th.

08/31/2026

Supreme/Larry Clark 

Larry Clark is an American photographer and film director who was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma in 1943. Between 1962 and 1971, Clark photographed his friends in their most private moments. Clark made the pictures as a participant rather than a detached observer, and in so doing, pioneered a raw, deeply personal approach to documentary photography. The resulting book, Tulsa, is considered one of the most influential and important collections of American photography — both for its exposure of the quotidian violence and self-destruction in everyday American society, and for the seismic impact it made on generations of American photographers who went on to make autobiographical pictures of their own lives and communities on the fringes, from Nan Goldin to Ryan McGinley. Clark followed Tulsa in 1983 with Teenage Lust, and made his directorial debut in 1995 with Kids.

Supreme has worked with Larry Clark repeatedly over the past 30 years. A new collection for Fall 2026 features original photography from Tulsa as well as new photographs made exclusively for Supreme. The collection consists of a Hooded Varsity Jacket, L/S Top, Hooded Sweatshirt, two T-Shirts, Skateboard, Bean Bag and Zine.

Available September 3rd.

Available in Asia September 5th.

Supreme®/Nike® Air Max 2001 Air Ecstasy

Supreme has worked with Nike® on a new version of the Air Max 2001 Air Ecstasy.

The shoe features a quilted mesh upper with 3M® Reflective TPU logo at side and heel, rubber outsole and Phylon midsole with transparent air bags, co-branded footbed with mesh collar and tongue lining, reflective lace loops and panel at tongue, and debossed graphics at heel and midsole. Made exclusively for Supreme, the Air Max 2001 Air Ecstasy will be offered in three color ways.

Available August 27th.

Available in Asia August 29th.

Supreme®/Yuketen

Yuketen is a footwear company established in 1989 by Japanese designer Yuki Matsuda. Yuketen is known for its distinctive approach to traditional American footwear, meticulous craftsmanship and high quality.

Supreme has worked with Yuketen on a custom version of the Leo. The shoe features a hand-cut, vegetable-tanned leather upper, durable Vibram® outsole, debossed co-branded footbed and engraved logo metal plate at heel. Hand-woven in Mexico exclusively for Supreme, the Leo will be offered in three color ways.

Available June 25th.

Available in Asia June 27th.

Supreme®/La Martina

La Martina is an official supplier of the Argentinean Polo Association and the Federation of International Polo. La Martina was founded in the mid-1980s by Lando Simonetti, then working in the fashion industry in the United States. Upon returning to his native Argentina, Simonetti established La Martina primarily as a premium polo leather goods manufacturer, specializing in boots and saddles. Over time, La Martina has expanded to offer polo apparel, and is regarded for its high performance standards and enduring quality.

Supreme has worked with La Martina on a collection for Spring 2026. The collection consists of a Jacket, Rugby, Soccer Jersey, Zip Up Sweatshirt, Sweatpant and 6-Panel Hat.

Available June 11th.

Available in Asia June 13th.
